description: Defines models and methods for managing relations between users, products, and analytic accounts in an Odoo module, including recursive account lookup and onchange handlers for timesheet entries.

classes.name: analytic_user_funct_grid
classes.description: Relation table between users and products on an analytic account

classes.name: account_analytic_account

methods.name: _get_related_user_account_recursiv
methods.description: Recursively searches for user-analytic account relations, traversing parent accounts if necessary
